title: ROI Tracking: A Comprehensive Guide for Marketers

facts.fact: The ClicData guide 'ROI Tracking: A Comprehensive Guide for Marketers' was originally published on October 25, 2023, by author Telmo Silva.
The ClicData guide 'ROI Tracking: A Comprehensive Guide for Marketers' was last updated on August 7, 2025.
In the guide's illustrative example of a marketing goal (not a sourced benchmark), a business might aim to increase UK website traffic by 15% in Q4.
facts.quote: For example, maybe your goal is to increase website traffic in the UK by 15% in Q4.
